physical_membership_rule: Files that are (1) source components of the agent contract/registry infrastructure (periphery/agent_contracts.py, periphery/agent_registry.py), (2) executable unit tests whose PRIMARY target is agent_contracts.py or agent_registry.py or a governance invariant over AGENT_REGISTRY, or (3) structural placeholders in the agent testing namespace. Excludes Wave002 operational agent files in periphery/agents/ (those are consumers of agent_contracts, not tests). Excludes Wave001 config registry files. Excludes Wave003 MMONDE pack files.

entries.purpose: Defines the NonSovereignAgentSpec dataclass contract: agents declare can_emit_act=False, can_authorize=False, can_mutate_kernel=False, can_write_memory=False. assert_safe() enforces these at instantiation time.
entries.claim_text: All Obsidia operational agents must declare non-sovereignty through NonSovereignAgentSpec. assert_safe() raises AssertionError if any sovereignty flag is set True.

entries.purpose: Defines AGENT_REGISTRY dict mapping agent_id strings to run callables for all 14 Wave002 operational Python agents. Provides list_agents() and run_registered_agent() API.
entries.claim_text: AGENT_REGISTRY maps all registered operational agent IDs to their run functions. run_registered_agent delegates execution to the correct agent.

entries.collector: pytest auto-discovery — test_*.py pattern in tests/periphery/
entries.claim_text: NonSovereignAgentSpec.assert_safe() accepts a spec with can_emit_act=False (test_agent_spec_safe). NonSovereignAgentSpec.assert_safe() raises AssertionError when can_emit_act=True (test_agent_spec_rejects_act).
entries.limitations: 2 tests only. Does not test can_authorize, can_mutate_kernel, can_write_memory flags independently. Does not test AgentLayer enum values. PASS is a unit assertion — it does not prove runtime enforcement of non-sovereignty for all action types or all agent implementations.

entries.limitations: Tests only 2 of the 14 registered agents. Does not verify all agent IDs in AGENT_REGISTRY. Does not test run_registered_agent for unknown IDs in this file. PASS does not prove correct behavior for all ActionCandidate input variants.

entries.claim_text: No agent in AGENT_REGISTRY returns packet.can_emit_act=True (test_no_agent_can_emit_act). action_sequence_agent, feedback_memory_agent, world_action_agent declare can_authorize=False and can_emit_act=False on their SPEC (test_no_agent_can_authorize). world_action_agent_v4 returns world_action_allowed=False and dry_run_only=True (test_world_action_agent_cannot_emit_real_action). feedback_memory_agent_v3 returns memory_write_allowed=False (test_feedback_memory_agent_cannot_write). control_plane run returns packet with can_emit_act=False (test_control_plane_cannot_emit_act_v3).
entries.limitations: Tests AGENT_REGISTRY as constituted at collection time. Adding a new agent with can_emit_act=True to AGENT_REGISTRY would cause test_no_agent_can_emit_act to fail — but does not prevent such addition before tests are re-run. Does not cover the 52 MMONDE agents (Wave003 scope). PASS is a runtime assertion on the test fixture ActionCandidate — not a formal proof for all possible inputs.

entries.failure_cause: FileNotFoundError: ROOT is computed as Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] which resolves to periphery/ (parent of periphery/modules_agents/). The script then looks for periphery/10_AGENTS_52/agents_52.registry.json which does not exist. Correct path requires the OBSIDIA_MMONDE_REVERSE_OS_34ARBRES_AGENTS_P2PLUS_V1 intermediate directory: periphery/OBSIDIA_MMONDE_REVERSE_OS_34ARBRES_AGENTS_P2PLUS_V1/10_AGENTS_52/agents_52.registry.json
entries.claim_text_intended: agents_52.registry.json contains exactly 52 agents. 5 named agents (OBSIDIA_ATLAS_INGESTOR, CANON_GUARDIAN, GRAPH_BUILDER, TERMINAL_BUILDER, PROOF_SENTINEL) are present. All entries have non-empty input, output, boundary, sortie_principale, prompt_systeme, and non_decision fields.
entries.limitations: BLOCKED: path hardcoded to wrong location. Test intent is structurally valid but physically unexecutable as-is. Repair requires updating ROOT computation from parents[1] to parents[2], or hardcoding the full MMONDE pack path.
